description: For repos that are neither deployed nor worked on. Renovate keeps running here but proposes nothing, and that is what clears out the PRs it already opened: a branch whose update is no longer wanted is pruned, and its PR is closed with it. Uninstalling the app or setting `enabled: false` would stop Renovate before it got that far, leaving every open PR where it is. To bring a repo back, point its renovate.json at the default preset instead.
